provenance: Ren's disposition of seven Round 03 adversarial reports. Acceptance means the finding governs further work. It does not mean the finding is closed.

findings.title: Caller-controlled schema forks can manufacture authority
findings.residual_risk: Repository-owned schemas do not create an external issuance boundary.
findings.next_test: Against the Round 04 freeze, inject relaxed schemas and forged authority through every exported validator and CLI.

findings.title: Graph validation does not prove fail-closed reachability
findings.residual_risk: A novel graph topology may still create a consequential bypass.
findings.next_test: Generate cyclic, branching and multi-condition graphs and prove failed or unknown branches cannot reach consequential nodes.

findings.title: A scope-only split can rewrite a proposition
findings.residual_risk: Text equality cannot prove identical real-world meaning or estimand.
findings.next_test: Attempt semantic rewrites through split, merge and coordinated resealing against the frozen ledger.

findings.title: Executable IF logic can omit a public condition
findings.residual_risk: Correct structural coverage does not prove the condition is true or sufficient.
findings.next_test: Mutate nested AST clauses and public renderings independently and require exact bidirectional coverage.

findings.title: Unrelated evidence can satisfy independent-source rules
findings.residual_risk: Declared independence groups remain unauthenticated and may share hidden inputs.
findings.next_test: Attack source families, empty observations, shared transformations and hidden upstream dependence.

findings.title: Public evolution projection can expose sensitive challenge data
findings.residual_risk: Local redaction rules do not establish consent, lawful processing or re-identification safety.
findings.next_test: Run privacy attacks using health, employment, whistleblower and small-cohort challenge records.

findings.title: Recovery can complete before containment starts
findings.residual_risk: Calendar validity does not prove real recovery capacity or funding.
findings.next_test: Attack start, expiry, resource-validity and recovery boundaries at exact and date-only precision.

findings.title: Self-review can be labelled independent
findings.residual_risk: Distinct local identifiers do not prove organisational or financial independence.
findings.next_test: Require external identity and control evidence, then attack aliases, subsidiaries and delegated reviewers.

findings.title: Duplicate harms can flip the inaction headline
findings.residual_risk: Unique records can still encode overlapping harms or invalid aggregation.
findings.next_test: Attack semantic duplicates, overlapping taxonomies, population weights and non-compensable harms.

findings.title: Unscored narrative can imply a forecast
findings.residual_risk: Controlled phrases can still imply probability or inevitability through context and hierarchy.
findings.next_test: Use human reviewers and adversarial paraphrases across every rendered path field and crop.

findings.title: Raw-input containment follows escaping symlinks
findings.residual_risk: Platform-specific filesystem behaviour may differ from the tested environment.
findings.next_test: Attack symlinks, hard links, traversal, races and non-regular files on supported deployment platforms.

findings.title: Blocked path branches can advance
findings.residual_risk: This converges with R03-EXT-02 and still needs independent graph search.
findings.next_test: Reproduce the original skip-forward mutation and fuzz all branch targets against Round 04.

findings.title: Preparation evidence has no population or geography join
findings.residual_risk: Compatible labels do not prove population linkage or transportability.
findings.next_test: Swap population, geography, denominator, unit and period independently and require fail-closed joins.

findings.title: Forecast outcomes are asserted rather than reconstructed
findings.residual_risk: Retained local bytes do not authenticate the publisher or resolution authority.
findings.next_test: Mutate outcome bits, evidence bytes, resolver versions and event rules; withhold scoring unless reconstruction is exact.

findings.title: One event can manufacture many independent clusters
findings.residual_risk: Different event IDs can still hide common shocks or dependent resolution processes.
findings.next_test: Attack aliases, correlated targets, duplicate events and claimed cluster identity before calibration output.

findings.title: Duplicate harm records alter action comparison
findings.residual_risk: This converges with R03-EXT-09 and aggregation validity remains unproven.
findings.next_test: Reproduce both duplication directions and test declared non-overlapping harm dimensions.

findings.title: Public signal ceiling drops units and denominators
findings.residual_risk: A complete label can remain misunderstood or visually separated from a value.
findings.next_test: Mutate every estimand field and verify changed public text, exports, crops and assistive descriptions.

findings.title: Forecast-language guard omits hashed outcome scope
findings.residual_risk: Language lint cannot determine meaning, implication or public interpretation.
findings.next_test: Attack every scope and generated ceiling field with numeric, probabilistic, crisis and inevitability claims.

findings.title: NERO reacquisition assurance is self-referential
findings.residual_risk: The historical archive bytes were not retained, so the claimed reconstruction cannot be independently repeated.
findings.next_test: Acquire immutable authorised archive bytes, bind the prior capture checksum and reproduce the baseline from those bytes.

findings.title: Severe harms are averaged away
findings.residual_risk: The non-compensation rule is a programme value choice, not legitimate affected-party adoption.
findings.next_test: Reproduce concentrated severe-harm cases and require per-party veto before any aggregate comparison.

findings.title: A caller can self-certify necessity instead of consent
findings.residual_risk: A structurally distinct necessity record does not prove lawful, independent or proportionate necessity.
findings.next_test: Attack party binding, alternatives, dissent, expiry, appeal and reviewer independence with external rights review.

findings.title: Known omitted groups vanish from the public claim ceiling
findings.residual_risk: Rendered omissions may remain inaccessible or insufficient for people excluded by the model.
findings.next_test: Mutate population omissions and verify they remain adjacent in screen, export, print and quoted excerpts.

findings.title: First screen presents a derived estimate as data
findings.residual_risk: Visible labels and reduced typography do not prove readers understand the inference boundary.
findings.next_test: Run unaided first-screen comprehension tests across mobile, low numeracy and assistive routes.

findings.title: The experiment denies harms it later measures
findings.residual_risk: A stronger protocol draft is not ethics approval, recruitment authority, support capacity or remediation.
findings.next_test: Obtain independent ethics determination and verify withdrawal, debrief, support, remediation and adverse-event ownership before recruitment.

findings.title: Public primer universalises candidate IFs
findings.residual_risk: Readers may still interpret the branded IF list as exhaustive or strictly necessary.
findings.next_test: Compare IF wording with plain condition language and score necessity, sufficiency and open-world comprehension.

findings.title: Editorial emphasis is laundered as evidence
findings.residual_risk: The programme names the value-choice problem but lacks adopted loss functions and affected-party priority rules.
findings.next_test: Predeclare rival editorial loss functions and show how concentrated harm changes prominence and release decisions.

findings.title: Competing-path enforcement permits a convenient singleton
findings.residual_risk: A schema cannot discover omitted mechanisms or prove a registered competitor is strongest.
findings.next_test: Require all known credible accounts or public omission reasons, then seek missing paths through independent domain review.

findings.title: Logical roles collapse into one global AND
findings.residual_risk: A structured route remains an incomplete model of necessary and sufficient real-world conditions.
findings.next_test: Attack alternative sufficient routes, enabling clauses and decision rules under every condition state.

findings.title: Provider capability and scope are unchecked
findings.residual_risk: Caller-declared capability and identity remain externally unverified.
findings.next_test: Swap actor capability, jurisdiction, geography, service and period, then add external capability evidence.

findings.title: Affectedness can be reassigned to a powerful actor
findings.residual_risk: Actor classification is still caller-authored and cannot establish representation or consent.
findings.next_test: Attack affected-party identity, representation, omission and role reassignment with affected reviewers.

findings.title: Agency signals lack executable metrics
findings.residual_risk: Content-addressed metric definitions do not prove measurement validity or independence.
findings.next_test: Mutate measure, unit, denominator, source and direction and require exact public and decision changes.

findings.title: Counter and harm signals can come from another condition
findings.residual_risk: Explicit cross-condition rationales may still permit narrative laundering.
findings.next_test: Swap condition, population, geography and time across intended, counter and harm signals.

findings.title: Caller-controlled clocks preserve stale plans
findings.residual_risk: Evaluator time is still a caller input until provided by a trusted execution boundary.
findings.next_test: Evaluate stale, future, date-only and adversarial clock records at a separately supplied trusted instant.

findings.title: Completion criteria and dependency cycles are hidden
findings.residual_risk: Visible criteria do not prove completion, verifier legitimacy or recoverable dependency resolution.
findings.next_test: Attack empty evidence, self-verification, cycles and blocked strongly connected actor groups.

findings.title: Relevant providers may disappear
findings.residual_risk: Declared exclusions cannot prove that all materially relevant actors were found.
findings.next_test: Remove each controller, duty bearer, funder, deliverer and negotiator and require a public exclusion.

findings.title: Narrative implies prediction and exhaustive diagnosis
findings.residual_risk: Readers may still infer inevitability from conditional WHEN framing.
findings.next_test: Run comprehension tests on the revised hypothesis language and open-world route limitation.

findings.title: Current fixtures share no condition identity
findings.residual_risk: Independent valid fixtures can still be mistaken for one programme state.
findings.next_test: Make one canonical condition identifier resolve through every subsystem without aliases or fallback.

findings.title: Similar public outcomes are not the same scope
findings.residual_risk: Textually similar people, outcome, place and period fields may refer to different worlds.
findings.next_test: Bind one outcome-scope hash across all participating artefacts and reject every single-field drift.

findings.title: Condition anchors are structurally incompatible
findings.residual_risk: Local hashes bind unlike projections and cannot establish shared semantics.
findings.next_test: Derive every downstream condition anchor from the same evolution-ledger state and byte identity.

findings.title: Decision-ready signal and preparation states are unreachable
findings.residual_risk: Separate fixtures cannot demonstrate a real evidence-to-preparation chain.
findings.next_test: Bind one signal evaluation to one condition and one preparation expression under identical scope and evidence.

findings.title: IF grammar has no shared source of truth
findings.residual_risk: Multiple valid renderers can emit incompatible public IF statements.
findings.next_test: Choose the evolution ledger as the condition-history root and derive all public IF clauses from it.

findings.title: Path anchor does not resolve to a ledger
findings.residual_risk: A path can name a locally plausible condition without proving current ledger state.
findings.next_test: Reject path registration unless every condition anchor resolves to exact current ledger bytes.

findings.title: Dashboard cannot consume a typed path
findings.residual_risk: The public surface can only withhold paths, not explain a validated path state.
findings.next_test: Project an exact validated path reference into the dashboard without accepting untyped narrative.

findings.title: Forecasts do not bind targets or actions to other contracts
findings.residual_risk: A correctly scored forecast may be irrelevant to the condition or proposed preparation.
findings.next_test: Bind forecast target, intervention state and decision use to the canonical condition, scope and action hypothesis.

findings.title: Cross-system evidence independence is unprotected
findings.residual_risk: Independent subsystem checks can count the same source family as several corroborating signals.
findings.next_test: Resolve transitive source families across the complete bundle and reject reused evidence roles.

findings.title: Actor and affected-party identity is fragmented
findings.residual_risk: Local actor references cannot authenticate people, representation or mandates.
findings.next_test: Use one actor registry across scope, agency, preparation and authority while retaining external verification states.

findings.title: Condition state axes are mixed
findings.residual_risk: Lifecycle, truth, measurement, evidence and decision states can still be read as interchangeable.
findings.next_test: Crosswalk every state explicitly and reject any implicit conversion between lifecycle, evidence and action eligibility.

findings.title: Experiment is not an executable protocol package
findings.residual_risk: A prose design can be changed after results and does not establish ethical recruitment.
findings.next_test: Freeze stimuli, facts, scripts, coding, outcomes, analysis, harms and stop rules in a content-addressed package.

findings.title: Full live suite was red during audit
findings.residual_risk: A later green run does not establish semantic correctness or stable clean-room reproduction.
findings.next_test: Run the complete suite from a clean checkout of the Round 04 commit and publish exact output.

findings.title: No authorised action can be read as wait
findings.residual_risk: Prominent safety wording does not prove readers distinguish no authority from safe inaction.
findings.next_test: Ask affected readers what they would do now and fail on passive-wait or false-safety interpretations.

findings.title: Affected readers have no working challenge or help route
findings.residual_risk: The prototype can disclose that no route exists, but it cannot create a staffed, safe and accountable service.
findings.next_test: Before consequential release, verify a human-owned challenge, correction, urgent-help, appeal and remedy route end to end.

findings.title: Mobile hides what now
findings.residual_risk: Static viewport position does not establish comprehension, reflow or assistive equivalence.
findings.next_test: Test the first minute on 320px, 400% zoom, touch, keyboard and screen-reader routes.

findings.title: Public goal is not visible as a contestable value choice
findings.residual_risk: Labelling a proposed goal does not supply democratic or affected-party adoption.
findings.next_test: Ask readers to identify who chose the goal, whether they may disagree and which alternatives remain legitimate.

findings.title: Large derived number becomes a transition score
findings.residual_risk: A demoted number may still anchor recall or appear as a verdict when copied.
findings.next_test: Measure unaided recall and inferred decision meaning against a no-number and conventional-release control.

findings.title: Confidence dimensions remain hidden or collapsed
findings.residual_risk: Plain states may still be conflated into one confidence judgement.
findings.next_test: Test source authenticity, measurement, applicability, inference, timing and decision readiness separately.

findings.title: Signal roles are absent from the public reasoning chain
findings.residual_risk: Readers cannot see which evidence role supports, counters or could harm each condition reading.
findings.next_test: Render all registered signal roles per condition without turning coverage into confidence or progress.

findings.title: Actor-specific WHENs are not rendered
findings.residual_risk: The central supply-side thesis remains documentation rather than an inspectable public state.
findings.next_test: Render every material actor's conditional work, completion test, dependency, expiry and unverified capability.

findings.title: Three condition vocabularies lack a mapping
findings.residual_risk: Competing lenses may be mistaken for universal or interchangeable ontologies.
findings.next_test: Publish a purpose-specific crosswalk and test whether readers can select the right lens without conflation.

findings.title: Harms are not a first-class current state
findings.residual_risk: An unknown harm state is not a real assessment of action, inaction, distribution or information harm.
findings.next_test: Project typed harm states and make every missing assessment visible without implying zero harm.

findings.title: Positive and adverse paths are not equally legible
findings.residual_risk: Equal wording can still hide asymmetrical evidence or frame refusal as failure.
findings.next_test: Render supported, unsupported and omitted positive, adverse, refusal, reduction and no-deployment paths proportionally to evidence.

findings.title: The Observatory is not yet a monitoring instrument
findings.residual_risk: Showing monitoring inactive does not create a cadence, owner, data supply or failure response.
findings.next_test: Require a governed owner, next check, delay rule and failure handling before displaying active monitoring.

findings.title: Technical language, disclaimer fatigue and scenario prominence obstruct the doorway
findings.residual_risk: Simplified hierarchy still needs low-literacy, multilingual, accessibility and worked-example validation.
findings.next_test: Compare a plain-question first layer, the seven labels and a conventional release with affected readers.

findings.title: The grammar is not a validated binding-condition diagnosis
findings.residual_risk: A promising grammar may still omit conditions, invite post-hoc rescue or add no value over simpler methods.
findings.next_test: Pre-register heterogeneous promises and compare independent encoders with assumptions registers and causal diagrams.

findings.title: Poverty nowcasts and the top-fifth inference were overstated
findings.residual_risk: Live linked sources can revise and the exact downloaded data and metadata are not yet frozen in the claim ledger.
findings.next_test: Freeze source bytes, query metadata, threshold, PPP vintage, reference year and modelled status before publication.

findings.title: Consumer IFs and actor WHENs are linked but not identical
findings.residual_risk: The actor mapping may still omit a mediator, dependency, refusal right or legitimate provider route.
findings.next_test: Encode actor-specific mediating relations and ask affected parties which conditions and providers were omitted.

findings.title: Repository controls do not enforce public issuance
findings.residual_risk: Any caller can bypass repository validators, host alternate output or forge local identity.
findings.next_test: Build and independently attack an externally enforced identity, signing, publication, correction and revocation boundary.

findings.title: Australia is a feasibility candidate rather than proof
findings.residual_risk: NERO, business AI adoption and occupational exposure describe different units and do not identify causal worker outcomes.
findings.next_test: Freeze one cohort and vintage, obtain source-independent outcomes and adoption evidence, and preregister rival causal graphs.

findings.title: The public communication intervention remains unvalidated
findings.residual_risk: The IF frame may add anxiety, causal overreach or false authority without improving decisions.
findings.next_test: Randomise conventional, scope-and-uncertainty and full-IF presentations with identical facts and predeclared harms.

findings.title: Primary-source ceilings and denominators must remain attached
findings.residual_risk: Narrative documents can still contain material claims outside the machine-readable claim system.
findings.next_test: Inventory every material sentence, bind exact retained evidence and reject unit, population, place, period or inference drift.
